questions.stem: Which type of electromagnetic wave is used in microwave ovens to heat food?
questions.explanation: Microwaves are absorbed by water molecules in food, causing them to vibrate and generate heat, cooking the food from within.

questions.stem: Which EM wave is used in TV remote controls?
questions.explanation: TV remote controls use infrared radiation to send coded signals to the TV. Infrared is also used in thermal imaging cameras and fibre optic communications.

questions.stem: X-rays are used in medicine because they:

options.text: Pass through soft tissue but are absorbed by bone and metal
Are absorbed by soft tissue but pass through bone
Are completely safe for the body

questions.explanation: X-rays pass through soft tissue but are absorbed by denser materials like bone and metal, which is why they can create images of the skeleton.

questions.stem: Which EM wave can cause sunburn and increase the risk of skin cancer?
questions.explanation: Ultraviolet (UV) radiation from the Sun can cause sunburn, premature ageing of skin, and increase the risk of skin cancer.

questions.stem: Gamma rays are used in medicine to:
questions.explanation: Gamma rays are used to sterilise medical equipment (killing bacteria) and in radiotherapy to destroy cancer cells.

questions.stem: Which type of EM wave is used for satellite communication and mobile phones?
questions.explanation: Microwaves are used for satellite communications, mobile phone networks, and GPS because they can pass through the atmosphere with minimal absorption.

questions.stem: Radio waves are used for broadcasting because they:

options.text: Are the most dangerous type of EM wave
Have the highest energy of all EM waves
Can travel long distances and pass through walls

questions.explanation: Radio waves can travel long distances and pass through most building materials, making them ideal for TV, radio, and WiFi broadcasting.
